# 1010. Pairs of Songs With Total Durations Divisible by 60

## Solution 1 (time O(n), space O(n))

```python
class Solution(object):
    def numPairsDivisibleBy60(self, time):
        """
        :type time: List[int]
        :rtype: int
        """
        d = collections.defaultdict(int)
        ans = 0
        for t in time:
            ans += d[(60 - t) % 60]
            d[t % 60] += 1
        return ans
```
